name: Boku no Tomodachi wa Mama de Asobu Tame ni Yattekuru ~**-kun Genki? Watashi, Minna ni Kakowarete Shiawase na Katei Tsukuruu~
original_name: 僕の友達はママで遊ぶためにやって来る ～○○君元気? 私、みんなに囲われて幸せな家庭作るぅ～
source:
Antisocial friends catch your (protagonist) weakness and uses it to blackmail your mother for sex.

She'll do anything for her family, but also falls to her own sexual estrum.
